verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents a dedicated `humanlayer automation run` command for running a coding session from a CI job, a cron machine or a server script. Launch tokens are documented for non-interactive shells without a PTY, which covers headless operation in pipelines and scripts. missing for 10: detailed docs on CLI flags, output and exit-code behavior for pipeline integration, evidence of running many sessions in parallel, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts

citations.quote: Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.
Use a launch token for one non-interactive command. Examples include a shell without an interactive PTY and a one-time remote bootstrap script.
